description.en: Who's who at Granny Maggie's table: parents, brothers and sisters, grandparents, cousins and friends.
description.sl: Kdo je kdo za mizo babice Maggie: starši, bratje in sestre, stari starši, bratranci in prijatelji.
description.it: Chi è chi alla tavola di nonna Maggie: genitori, fratelli e sorelle, nonni, cugini e amici.
description.de: Wer ist wer an Oma Maggies Tisch: Eltern, Geschwister, Großeltern, Cousins und Freunde.

words.example_it: Questa è la mia famiglia.
words.note: One family, two families: y becomes ies.
words.note_sl: Ena družina, dve: family, families (y postane ies).

words.example_en: This is my brother, and this is my sister.
words.example_sl: To je moj brat, to pa moja sestra.
words.example_it: Questo è mio fratello e questa è mia sorella.
words.example_de: Das ist mein Bruder, und das ist meine Schwester.
words.note: The same for everyone, a man or a woman: This is my mum. This is my dad.
words.note_sl: Enako za vsakogar, moškega ali žensko: This is my mum. This is my dad.
words.note_it: Uguale per tutti, uomo o donna (niente questo/questa): This is my mum. This is my dad.
words.note_de: Für alle gleich, Mann oder Frau: This is my mum. This is my dad.

words.example_it: La mamma è in cucina.
words.note: British Mum, American Mom. With a capital letter when you use it as her name.
words.note_sl: Britansko Mum, ameriško Mom. Z veliko začetnico, ko jo tako kličeš.
words.note_it: In britannico Mum, in americano Mom. Con la maiuscola quando la chiami così.
words.note_de: Britisch Mum, amerikanisch Mom. Großgeschrieben, wenn du sie so nennst.

words.example_it: Il papà lavora in fattoria.
words.note: Father is the formal word; small children say Daddy.
words.note_sl: Father je uradna beseda; majhni otroci rečejo daddy.
words.note_it: Father è la parola formale; i bambini piccoli dicono daddy.
words.note_de: Father ist das förmliche Wort; kleine Kinder sagen daddy.

words.example_it: I miei genitori sono a casa.
words.note: One of them: a parent. Aunts, uncles and cousins are relatives.
words.note_sl: Eden od njiju: a parent. Tete, strici in bratranci so relatives (sorodniki).
words.note_it: Falso amico: parents sono i genitori; i parenti sono relatives.
words.note_de: Ein Elternteil: a parent. Tanten, Onkel und Cousins sind relatives (Verwandte).

words.example_sl: Moj brat je star sedem let.
words.example_it: Mio fratello ha sette anni.
words.note: Brothers and sisters together: people just say brothers and sisters (siblings is a formal word).
words.note_sl: Bratje in sestre skupaj: brothers and sisters (siblings je bolj uradno).
words.note_it: Fratelli e sorelle insieme: brothers and sisters (siblings è più formale).
words.note_de: Geschwister: meist brothers and sisters (siblings ist förmlich).

words.example_en: My sister is reading a book.
words.example_it: Mia sorella legge un libro.
Nonna Maggie è la nonna di Poppy.
words.note: Granny and grandma are the warm words: Granny Maggie.
words.note_sl: Topleje: granny ali grandma, kot Granny Maggie.
words.note_it: Più affettuoso: granny o grandma, come Granny Maggie.
words.note_de: Liebevoller: granny oder grandma, wie Granny Maggie.

words.example_it: Il signor Tyson è il nonno di Alfie.
words.note: Grandad and grandpa are the warm words.

words.example_it: Harry è il figlio della signora Birkett.
words.note: Son and sun sound the same.
words.note_sl: Son (sin) in sun (sonce) se izgovorita enako.
words.note_it: Son (figlio) e sun (sole) si pronunciano uguale.

words.example_en: The farmer's daughter feeds the hens.
words.example_it: La figlia del contadino dà da mangiare alle galline.
words.example_de: Die Tochter des Bauern füttert die Hühner.

words.example_en: The children are playing by the beck.
words.example_it: I bambini giocano vicino al ruscello.
words.note: One child, two children: an irregular plural. In everyday talk also kids.
words.note_sl: En otrok, dva otroka: child, children (nepravilna množina). V vsakdanjem govoru tudi kids.
words.note_it: Plurale irregolare: one child, two children. Nella lingua di tutti i giorni anche kids.
words.note_de: Unregelmäßige Mehrzahl: one child, two children. Umgangssprachlich auch kids.

words.example_en: The baby is sleeping. Be quiet!
words.example_it: Il bebè dorme. Fai silenzio!

words.example_en: My uncle has got a tractor.
words.example_it: Mio zio ha un trattore.

words.example_en: Auntie Edna is listening to the radio.
words.example_it: La zia Edna ascolta la radio.
words.note: Auntie is the warm word: Auntie Edna.
words.note_it: Più affettuoso: auntie, come Auntie Edna.

words.example_it: Mio cugino abita a Kendal.
words.note: One word for a boy or a girl.
words.note_sl: Ena beseda za bratranca in sestrično.
words.note_it: Una sola parola per cugino e cugina.
words.note_de: Ein Wort für Cousin und Cousine.

words.example_it: Harry è il mio migliore amico.
words.note: A friend is just a friend; a boyfriend or a girlfriend is more. In Cumbria you may hear marra (friend).
words.note_sl: Friend je prijatelj ali prijateljica; fant ali punca je boyfriend, girlfriend. V Cumbrii slišiš tudi marra (prijatelj).
words.note_it: Friend è amico o amica; il fidanzato è boyfriend, la fidanzata girlfriend. In Cumbria si sente anche marra (amico).
words.note_de: Ein friend ist nur ein Freund; der feste Freund ist boyfriend, die feste Freundin girlfriend. In Cumbria hörst du auch marra (Freund).

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett is a very busy woman.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett je zelo zaposlena ženska.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett è una donna molto indaffarata.
words.example_de: Frau Birkett ist eine sehr beschäftigte Frau.
words.note: One woman, two women: women sounds like 'wimin'.

words.example_en: The man with the dog is Shepherd Jack.
words.example_sl: Moški s psom je pastir Jack.
words.example_it: L'uomo con il cane è il pastore Jack.
words.example_de: Der Mann mit dem Hund ist Schäfer Jack.
words.note: One man, two men: an irregular plural.
words.note_sl: En moški, dva moška: man, men (nepravilna množina).
words.note_it: Plurale irregolare: one man, two men.
words.note_de: Unregelmäßige Mehrzahl: one man, two men.

words.example_it: Il cane di Jack si chiama Meg.
Il gatto di Poppy si chiama Tibbs.

words.example_en: I've got a sister and two brothers.
words.example_it: Ho una sorella e due fratelli.
words.example_de: Ich habe eine Schwester und zwei Brüder.
words.note: British English: I've got = I have. The question: Have you got a dog?
words.note_sl: Britanska angleščina: I've got = I have. Vprašanje: Have you got a dog?
words.note_it: Inglese britannico: I've got = I have. La domanda: Have you got a dog?
words.note_de: Britisches Englisch: I've got = I have. Die Frage: Have you got a dog?
